command.build.checkUpToDate: Check Whether Projects Are Up to Date
command.containers.attach: Attach to a Process in a Container…
command.debug.attachRemote: Attach to Process on a Remote Machine…
command.ef.model: Show the Model (Diagram and Debug View)
command.markdown.showPreviewToSide: Markdown: Open Preview to the Side
command.profiler.toggleHotLines: Show Hot Lines in the Editor
command.testing.coverAtCursor: Run Tests at Cursor with Coverage
command.testing.runNotRun: Run Tests That Have Not Run
customize.addAnyCommandToAMenu: Add any command to a menu, a context menu or a toolbar, remove items, change their order, or make toolbars of your own. Changes apply at once; Reset returns a menu to how it was. They're the setting Menu and Toolbar Customizations, so they belong to the profile and sync with it.
customize.backToTheItemsAsContributed: Back to the items as contributed
fontsAndColors.colorsOverTheThemeSFor: Colors over the theme's, for kinds of code, the editor and the window. Type a color (#RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA with transparency); Reset returns to the theme's. They're the settings Syntax Colors and Editor and Window Colors, in VS Code's form.
fontsAndColors.offColorsSetHereApplyTo: Off: colors set here apply to the active theme only
fontsAndColors.theEditorSFontFamilyAnd: The editor's font family and size (Settings)
liveTree.selectElementInTheAppClick: Select Element in the App: click an element in the running app to select it here
liveTree.showTheVisualTreeTemplatesParts: Show the visual tree (templates' parts too); off: the elements the XAML declares
plugins.noPluginsAreInstalledPutPlugins: No plugins are installed. Put plugins in the user plugins folder or pass --plugin-dir.
remotePorts.forwardAPortOfTheRemote: Forward a port of the remote machine
remotePorts.openTheSelectedForwardedPort: Open the selected forwarded port in the browser
setting.build.beforeRun.description: What F5 and Ctrl+F5 do before starting a project.
setting.build.beforeRun.enum.build: Build it (quick when it is up to date)
setting.build.beforeRun.enum.prompt: Ask when it is out of date
setting.build.beforeRun.title: Before Running
setting.build.binaryLog.description: Capture each build in a .binlog in the logs folder (the newest 20 are kept), for the binary log viewer and Build Timings.
setting.build.binaryLog.title: Write a Binary Log for Every Build
setting.build.fastUpToDateCheck.descript: Skip MSBuild when nothing a project builds from changed since its last build here (projects can opt out with DisableFastUpToDateCheck).
setting.build.fastUpToDateCheck.title: Fast Up-to-Date Check
setting.build.logFileVerbosity.descripti: Also write the build's log to build.log in the logs folder (Build: Open Build Log), at this verbosity.
setting.build.logFileVerbosity.title: Build Log File Verbosity
setting.build.maxParallelProjects.descri: How many projects MSBuild builds at once (its nodes). 0: one per processor.
setting.build.maxParallelProjects.title: Maximum Parallel Project Builds
setting.build.runAnalyzersDuringBuild.de: Run Roslyn analyzers during builds (RunAnalyzersDuringBuild). Live analysis in the editor isn't affected.
setting.build.runCustomToolsOnSave.descr: When a file with a custom tool (.resx, a text template…) is saved, generate its output.
setting.build.runCustomToolsOnSave.title: Run Custom Tools on Save
setting.build.saveAllBeforeBuild.descrip: Save every modified document before a build starts.
setting.build.saveAllBeforeBuild.title: Save All Before Build
setting.build.verbosity.description: How much MSBuild writes to Output → Build.
setting.build.verbosity.enum.detailed: Detailed: also the targets and low-importance messages
setting.build.verbosity.enum.normal: Normal: also the projects, command lines and copies
setting.build.verbosity.title: Build Output Verbosity
setting.codeCleanup.fixes.description: Diagnostic ids whose fixes Code Cleanup applies (empty: unused usings, simplified names, braces, accessibility modifiers, readonly fields, new(), file-scoped namespaces). Then it sorts usings and formats.
setting.codeCleanup.fixes.title: Code Cleanup Fixes
setting.codeCleanup.onSave.description: Run Code Cleanup on C# files before they are saved.
setting.codeCleanup.onSave.title: Run Code Cleanup on Save
setting.containers.fastMode.description: Run and debug a project in a container of its Dockerfile's base stage with the build output mounted, so a rebuild needs no image build. Off: the whole Dockerfile is built every time, and debugging attaches to the app.
setting.containers.fastMode.title: Fast Mode
setting.containers.tool.description: The container CLI that builds, runs and lists containers: docker, podman, or a command line such as 'wsl -d Ubuntu --exec podman'. Empty: docker when it is installed, else podman.
setting.containers.tool.title: Container Engine
setting.data.maxRows.description: The query editor shows at most this many rows of each result set; the results say when they were cut.
setting.data.maxRows.title: Maximum Rows per Result
setting.data.pageSize.description: Rows per page when viewing and editing a table's data.
setting.data.pageSize.title: Table Data Page Size
setting.debug.browser.description: The browser for debugging in the browser (Blazor WebAssembly, JavaScript): auto (Chrome, then Edge, then Chromium), chrome, edge, chromium, or the path of a Chromium browser.
setting.debug.browser.title: Browser
setting.debug.console.description: Where a console or web app debugged with Start Debugging gets its console: the Debug Console (output only), the integrated terminal, or a console window of its own (Windows, the default there). The terminal and the console window take input, and Detach All leaves the program running.
setting.debug.console.title: Console of debugged programs
setting.debug.containerTool.description: The container command line for attaching in containers: docker, podman, or one inside WSL such as "wsl -d Ubuntu --exec podman".
setting.debug.containerTool.title: Container tool
setting.debug.javaScript.description: Start Debugging opens an ASP.NET Core app's page in Chrome or Edge under the debugger, when its launch profile opens a browser, so breakpoints in its scripts bind too. Blazor WebAssembly components always debug in the browser.
setting.debug.javaScript.title: JavaScript debugging for ASP.NET Core
setting.debug.justMyCode.description: Step through and break in your own code only (optimized and framework code is stepped over).
setting.debug.justMyCode.title: Just My Code
setting.debug.liveVisualTree.description: Running or debugging an Avalonia app loads Daedalus Studio's agent into it (a .NET startup hook), for the Live Visual Tree and Live Property Explorer.
setting.debug.liveVisualTree.title: Live Visual Tree for Avalonia apps
setting.debug.perfTips.description: Show the time elapsed since the program was resumed at the end of the current statement's line.
setting.debug.perfTips.title: PerfTips
setting.debug.sourceFileMap.description: Source folders of programs debugged on another machine, as "/folder/there=C:\folder\here". Without one, a file is found in the solution by its folder and name.
setting.debug.sourceFileMap.title: Source file map
setting.debug.stepOverPropertiesAndOpera: Step Into steps over property getters and setters and operators (applies from the next session).
setting.diagnostics.crashReports.descrip: When Daedalus Studio crashes, save a report (version, OS, the error and recent log lines) in the logs folder on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.
setting.diagnostics.crashReports.title: Save Crash Reports
setting.diagnostics.showDiagnosticToolsO: Open the Diagnostic Tools window (CPU, memory, GCs, exceptions and the runtime's counters) when a debug session starts. While it is open, it follows the program being run or debugged either way.
Show Diagnostic Tools When Debugging Starts
setting.editor.autoClosingBrackets.descr: Insert the closing bracket or quote after typing an opening one, as the language defines them.
setting.editor.autoClosingBrackets.title: Auto Closing Brackets
setting.editor.bracketPairColorization.d: Color matching brackets by nesting depth.
setting.editor.codeLens.description: Show reference and implementation counts at the end of declarations.
setting.editor.codeLens.title: CodeLens
setting.editor.fontFamily.description: Comma-separated fonts for text views such as Output; the first installed one is used.
setting.editor.fontFamily.title: Font Family
setting.editor.fontSize.description: Font size in points for text views.
setting.editor.fontSize.title: Font Size
setting.editor.formatOnSave.description: Format the document with its language service before saving.
setting.editor.formatOnSave.title: Format on Save
setting.editor.formatOnType.description: Format the statement or block after typing ; or }.
setting.editor.formatOnType.title: Format on Type
setting.editor.guides.indentation.descri: Draw vertical lines at indentation levels.
setting.editor.guides.indentation.title: Indentation Guides
setting.editor.highlightCurrentLine.desc: Highlight the line with the caret.
setting.editor.inheritanceMargin.descrip: Show glyphs for members that implement, override or are overridden, with navigation.
setting.editor.inheritanceMargin.title: Inheritance Margin
setting.editor.inlayHints.parameterNames: Show parameter names before literal and new arguments.
setting.editor.inlayHints.types.descript: Show the inferred types of var declarations and lambda parameters.
setting.editor.inlayHints.types.title: Inlay Hints: Types
setting.editor.inlineDiagnostics.descrip: Show error and warning messages at the end of their line.
setting.editor.inlineDiagnostics.title: Inline Diagnostics
setting.editor.insertSpaces.description: Indent with spaces instead of tabs. An .editorconfig file overrides it.
setting.editor.insertSpaces.title: Insert Spaces
setting.editor.lineNumbers.title: Line Numbers
setting.editor.minimap.enabled.descripti: Show a miniature of the document beside the editor.
setting.editor.minimap.enabled.title: Minimap
setting.editor.navigationBar.description: Show the type and member drop-downs above the editor.
setting.editor.navigationBar.title: Navigation Bar
setting.editor.overviewRuler.description: Mark errors, warnings, changes, breakpoints, find results and the caret beside the scroll bar.
setting.editor.overviewRuler.title: Overview Ruler
setting.editor.renderWhitespace.title: Render Whitespace
setting.editor.rulers.description: Columns at which to draw vertical rulers, e.g. 120.
setting.editor.rulers.title: Rulers
setting.editor.stickyScroll.description: Keep the headers of the enclosing scopes at the top of the editor while scrolling.
setting.editor.stickyScroll.title: Sticky Scroll
setting.editor.tabSize.description: Columns per indentation level. An .editorconfig file overrides it.
setting.editor.tabSize.title: Tab Size
Colors over the theme's for kinds of code, as VS Code writes them: "comments", "strings", "keywords", "numbers", "types", "functions", "variables", or "semanticTokenColors" by token type; under "[Dark]" (a theme's name) for one theme only. Tools → Fonts and Colors edits them.
setting.editor.wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines in the editor.
setting.editor.wordWrap.title: Word Wrap
setting.files.autoRecover.description: Back up unsaved changes every 30 seconds and offer to restore them after a crash.
setting.files.autoRecover.title: AutoRecover
setting.hosting.ciStatus.description: Show the checks, pipelines or builds of the current branch, beside the branch and in Git Changes.
setting.hosting.ciStatus.title: Show CI Status
setting.hosting.enabled.description: Talk to GitHub, Azure DevOps and GitLab (pull requests, checks, work items) for the hosts you sign in to. Off: no hosting call is made.
setting.hosting.enabled.title: Git Hosting Integration
setting.hosting.reviewComments.descripti: Show the review comments of the current branch's pull request at their lines.
setting.hosting.reviewComments.title: Show Review Comments in the Editor
setting.hosting.showResolvedComments.des: Also show resolved review threads in the editor.
setting.hosting.statusRefreshSeconds.des: How often the CI status and the branch's pull request are read again while signed in.
setting.json.schemaDownload.description: Download schemas from SchemaStore.org (cached for a week) for JSON and YAML files without a bundled schema. Takes effect after a restart.
setting.json.schemaDownload.title: Download JSON Schemas
setting.keyboard.scheme.description: Default: the classic IDE shortcuts (F6 builds, Ctrl+Q searches, Ctrl+, goes to anything, F1 is help). VS Code: VS Code's (F1 is the command palette, Ctrl+, opens Settings, Ctrl+W closes). ReSharper: the default with ReSharper's (Ctrl+Shift+R refactors, Ctrl+W expands the selection, Alt+F7 finds usages). Emacs: the default with Emacs's editing keys (Ctrl+F/B/N/P move, Ctrl+K kills to the line's end, Ctrl+Space sets the mark, Ctrl+X Ctrl+S saves, Alt+X runs a command). Your own key bindings apply on top of any of them.
setting.keyboard.scheme.title: Keyboard Scheme
setting.languageServices.analysisScope.d: Where analyzers run in the background. Compiler errors are always reported for the whole solution.
setting.navigation.sourceLink.descriptio: Download the original source of library code from its Source Link URL (GitHub and the like) on Go to Definition. Embedded sources are always used; otherwise the code is decompiled.
setting.navigation.sourceLink.title: Source Link
setting.npm.restoreOnOpen.description: When a trusted solution opens with a package.json whose packages aren't installed: ask, restore (npm install), or do nothing.
setting.npm.restoreOnOpen.title: Restore npm Packages on Open
setting.npm.runtime.description: The npm that runs scripts and restores packages: yours (on PATH), else the built-in Node.js; or always the built-in Node.js.
setting.npm.runtime.enum.auto: The npm on PATH, else the built-in Node.js
setting.npm.runtime.title: npm
setting.nuget.offline.description: Use only local package sources (folders) and the global packages folder in the NuGet Package Manager. Restore is not affected.
setting.nuget.offline.title: Offline
setting.output.wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines in the Output window.
setting.output.wordWrap.title: Word Wrap
setting.plugins.disabled.description: The ids of plugins that don't load (the Plugins window turns them off and on). Changes apply when Daedalus Studio starts again.
setting.plugins.disabled.title: Turned-Off Plugins
setting.projects.restoreOnOpen.descripti: Restore NuGet packages in the background when a trusted solution opens.
setting.projects.restoreOnOpen.title: Restore on Open
setting.remote.autoForwardPorts.descript: In a remote window, forward ports that start listening on the remote machine (a web app's, a debug session's) to the same port here, or a free one.
setting.remote.autoForwardPorts.title: Forward Ports Automatically
setting.run.console.description: Where console and web apps run: their output in the Output window, the integrated terminal (they can read input), or a console window of their own (Windows, the default there).
setting.run.console.title: Console for Run Without Debugging
setting.run.externalConsole.description: Windows only: start console apps in a console window of their own (so they can read input) instead of showing their output in the Output window.
setting.run.externalConsole.title: Run Console Apps in an External Console
setting.run.hotReload.description: Run under dotnet watch on Ctrl+F5: saved edits are applied to the running app, which restarts when an edit can't be applied.
setting.run.hotReload.title: Hot Reload on Start Without Debugging
setting.settingsSync.ignoredSettings.des: Settings that stay on this machine (the sync settings always do), such as paths that differ between machines.
setting.settingsSync.target.description: Where your settings, keyboard shortcuts, snippets and saved layouts sync: a folder (one a cloud drive syncs) or a Git repository's URL (a gist's clone URL works). Empty: sync is off. Each profile has its own.
setting.settingsSync.target.title: Sync Target
setting.taskList.tokens.description: Comment tokens the Task List collects (a comment starting with one of them).
setting.taskList.tokens.title: Task List Tokens
setting.terminal.commandsToSkipShell.des: Command ids whose key bindings keep working while a terminal has focus; every other key goes to the shell. Empty: the built-in list (palette, F6, build, run, debug, terminal commands).
setting.terminal.copyOnSelect.descriptio: Copy selected text to the clipboard as soon as the selection ends.
setting.terminal.copyOnSelect.title: Copy on Selection
setting.terminal.defaultProfile.descript: The shell new terminals start. Empty: the first one found.
setting.terminal.defaultProfile.title: Default Profile
setting.terminal.fontFamily.description: Fonts for the terminal, comma-separated; empty uses the editor's font.
setting.terminal.fontFamily.title: Font Family
setting.terminal.fontSize.description: Font size in points; 0 uses the editor's size.
setting.terminal.fontSize.title: Font Size
setting.terminal.scrollback.description: Lines kept above the screen in each terminal (new terminals).
setting.terminal.scrollback.title: Scrollback
setting.terminal.shellIntegration.descri: Start bash, zsh and PowerShell with a script that reports the current directory and command marks (new terminals).
setting.terminal.shellIntegration.title: Shell Integration
setting.testing.historyLength.descriptio: How many earlier results of each test the Test Explorer keeps (shown in its details).
setting.testing.historyLength.title: Results Kept per Test
setting.testing.showExplorerOnRun.descri: Open the Test Explorer when a test run starts from a command or the editor.
setting.testing.showExplorerOnRun.title: Show Test Explorer When Running Tests
setting.update.channel.description: Stable releases, or nightly builds of the next version. Empty: the channel the installed build came from. Moving from nightly builds to stable releases installs the newest stable release, even when it is older, after a confirmation.
setting.update.channel.title: Update Channel
setting.update.mode.description: Installed builds keep themselves up to date: download new releases in the background and apply them when the IDE restarts, only say that one is available, or don't check at all (no update traffic; Help → Check for Updates still works). Development builds never check.
setting.update.mode.enum.auto: Download in the background and update at the next restart
setting.update.mode.enum.notify: Say that a release is available
setting.update.mode.title: Updates
setting.web.eslint.description: Lint JavaScript and TypeScript files with the project's own ESLint, where an ESLint configuration covers them (with the web language servers).
setting.web.eslint.title: ESLint
setting.web.languageServers.description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript editing uses language servers that run on Node.js, downloaded once into the cache folder: ask before downloading, download without asking, or don't use them.
setting.web.languageServers.enum.ask: Ask the first time a web file opens
setting.web.languageServers.title: Web Language Servers
setting.web.prettier.description: Format Document and format on save use the project's own Prettier when it is installed (node_modules) and configured (.prettierrc, prettier.config.js or package.json).
setting.web.prettier.title: Prettier
setting.workbench.colorCustomizations.de: Colors over the theme's for the editor (VS Code's ids, such as "editor.selectionBackground") and the window (resource keys such as "Shell.Background"); under "[Dark]" for one theme only. Tools → Fonts and Colors edits them.
setting.workbench.colorTheme.description: The color theme. Follow System uses the operating system's light, dark or high-contrast setting.
setting.workbench.colorTheme.title: Color Theme
setting.workbench.commandBarCustomizatio: Commands added to and removed from menus, context menus and the standard toolbar, their order, and your own toolbars: { "locations": { "menuBar/tools": { "add": [], "remove": [], "order": [] } }, "toolbars": { "Name": [] } }. Tools → Customize edits it.
setting.workbench.editor.colorTabsByProj: Mark each document tab with its project's color, a stripe along the tab's bottom edge.
setting.workbench.locale.description: The language of menus, commands and windows. Empty: the operating system's, when Daedalus Studio has it. qps-ploc and qps-plocm are pseudo-languages for testing translations (the second lays the window out right to left). Applies at the next start.
setting.workbench.locale.title: Display Language
setting.workbench.notifications.autoHide: Seconds after which informational toasts hide (they stay in the Notifications window). 0 keeps them until dismissed.
setting.workbench.statusBar.visible.desc: Show the status bar at the bottom of the window.
